_comment: Source of truth for the cli_commands[] portion of .vrooli/endpoints.json. Hand-maintained because the CLI is a separate Go module from the API; cross-module codegen would force one to import the other. Each entry mirrors a real subcommand registered in cli/domains/<dom>/register.go (or cli-core's StandardScenarioApp built-ins). Codegen verifies every cli_mapping.command in endpoints[] has a matching name here.

cli_commands.name: status
cli_commands.description: Check API and dependency health (auto-provided by cli-core's StandardScenarioApp)

cli_commands.name: notes attach
cli_commands.description: Upload an attachment for a note (--file PATH)

cli_commands.name: diagnostics run
cli_commands.description: Run the audio-tools capability suite end-to-end against bundled fixtures

cli_commands.name: diagnostics last
cli_commands.description: Show the most recent diagnostics suite result

cli_commands.name: health show
cli_commands.description: Show per-capability provider health (default human table; --json for proto JSON; --refresh to bypass cache)

cli_commands.name: health watch
cli_commands.description: Stream per-capability provider-health events until Ctrl-C

cli_commands.name: provider list
cli_commands.description: List local-tier providers with their current process_state and supported actions

cli_commands.name: provider start
cli_commands.description: Start a local provider (wraps `vrooli resource start <slug>`); use --dry-run to preview

cli_commands.name: provider stop
cli_commands.description: Stop a local provider (wraps `vrooli resource stop <slug>`); use --dry-run to preview

cli_commands.name: provider restart
cli_commands.description: Restart a local provider (wraps `vrooli resource restart <slug>`); use --dry-run to preview

cli_commands.name: provider pull-model
cli_commands.description: Pull a model on the ollama provider (ollama-only); use --dry-run to preview

cli_commands.name: provider logs
cli_commands.description: Stream stdout/stderr lines from a local provider's backing resource
